name: flow
description: Claude Code agents that work like a company, with Jev picking the right model for each task to keep cost down.

test_command.title: Test command
test_command.description: Core: What a worker runs to check its package, e.g. npm test. Empty: the tests covering the changed files.

full_check_command.title: Full check
full_check_command.description: Core: What the reviewer runs once per batch before pushing, e.g. npm run check. Empty: no full check (the reviewer says so).

deploy_command.title: Deploy command
deploy_command.description: Core: What the reviewer runs after pushing. Empty: no deploy.

merge_method.title: Merge method without a reviewer
merge_method.description: Advanced: gh pr merge method managers use when the reviewer is off.

merge_mode.title: Merge mode
merge_mode.description: Core: auto: the reviewer merges approved PRs. confirm: it waits for you to run /flow approve <pr>. A flow:confirm or flow:auto label on a PR overrides this.

push_mode.title: Push mode
push_mode.description: Core: auto: the reviewer pushes a batch once its full check is green. confirm: it builds and checks the batch, saves it and stops; you start the push with /flow push.

reviewer.title: Reviewer
reviewer.description: Advanced: On: managers hand PRs to one reviewer, which merges, runs the full check and deploys. Off: managers merge themselves.

max_managers.title: Managers at once
max_managers.description: Advanced: How many managers the main session runs at a time.

max_workers.title: Workers per manager
max_workers.description: Core: How many workers one manager runs at a time.

test_slots.title: Test slots
test_slots.description: Advanced: How many heavy test runs (a whole suite, the full check) may run at once across all agents of the session. Minimum 1.

typecheck_slots.title: Typecheck slots
typecheck_slots.description: How many typechecks (npm run typecheck, tsc) may run at once across all agents. A separate, lighter pool than the test slots. Minimum 1.

typecheck_commands.title: Typecheck commands
typecheck_commands.description: Advanced: Bash commands that run a typecheck. Flow refuses them unless the caller holds a typecheck slot (mcp__flow__test_slot kind typecheck). Empty: not enforced.

test_slot_commands.title: Test slot commands
test_slot_commands.description: Advanced: Bash commands that run a whole test suite. Flow refuses them unless the caller holds a test slot (mcp__flow__test_slot acquire). Empty: not enforced.

context_warn_percent.title: Context warning
context_warn_percent.description: Advanced: The Flow pane marks this percent of the context window on each agent's meter, and the meter turns yellow at or past it (1 to 100). Applies to windows under 1M.

context_warn_percent_1m.title: Context warning, 1M window
context_warn_percent_1m.description: Advanced: The same as the context warning, for agents on a 1M window (a [1m] model). The 200k percent never applies to them (1 to 100).

context_warn_tokens.title: Context limit in tokens
context_warn_tokens.description: Advanced: An optional cap over both percents: hand off at this many tokens, or at the percent of the window when that is lower (0 = off, percent only). Also places the meter marker.

handoff.title: Handoff
handoff.description: Advanced: On: a worker or manager that reaches the context warning percent is told to commit, push and write a handoff note, and its parent continues on a fresh agent. Off: the meter only shows.

size_feedback.title: Size feedback
size_feedback.description: Advanced: On: each manager's prompt gets, once at spawn, a short digest of how this repo's earlier workers' Size lines turned out (how many needed a rerun one size up). Local records only, no network. Off: no digest.

size_ab.title: Size A/B
size_ab.description: Advanced: daily: with decision_api jev, alternate by local day between sizing through Jev and the brief's Size line alone, and tag each spawn with its arm in the cost ledger; read the result with the size_ab_report tool or scripts/size-ab.mjs. off: no A/B, sizing as decision_api says.

best_of_n.title: Best of N
best_of_n.description: Advanced: brief: a manager may start 2-3 competing workers (arms) on one package when its task or the user asks for it; auto: also on its own for large packages and bug hunts whose root cause is unknown. Each arm has its own worktree and branch, the manager picks the winner with the arms tool and only that PR is handed over. Arms cost tokens, each counts against max_workers and the ledger records $ per arm. off: one worker per package.

best_of_n_arms.title: Best of N arms
best_of_n_arms.description: Advanced: how many competing workers at most for one package when best_of_n is on (2 or 3; other values are clamped).

main_checkout_guard.title: Main-checkout guard
main_checkout_guard.description: Advanced: On: Edit, Write and obvious shell writes (redirects, sed -i, git commit and friends) aimed at the repo's main checkout are refused, for every flow agent and the main session. Worktrees and .git/ stay writable.

main_checkout_allow.title: Main checkout: still writable
main_checkout_allow.description: Advanced: Comma-separated paths relative to the repo root that stay writable in the main checkout; one ending in / covers a directory.

max_continues.title: Max continues
max_continues.description: Advanced: After a branch has handed off this many times, the owning manager is told the package is too big and should be split. It only warns.

worker_model_small.title: Worker model, small briefs
worker_model_small.description: Advanced: Model alias for workers whose brief says `Size: small`. Normal maps to worker_model_normal, large to worker_model; a brief without a Size line uses worker_model.

worker_model_normal.title: Worker model, normal briefs
worker_model_normal.description: Advanced: Model alias for workers whose brief says `Size: normal`.

explore_model.title: Explore model
explore_model.description: Advanced: Model alias for read-only Explore sub-agents started by flow agents (not by the main session) when they name no model.

explore_effort.title: Explore effort
explore_effort.description: Advanced: Reasoning effort for Explore sub-agents started by flow agents. low, medium, high, xhigh or max; inherit keeps the session's effort. An explicit Agent effort, or CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL in the environment, wins.

worker_effort_small.title: Worker effort, small briefs
worker_effort_small.description: Advanced: Reasoning effort for workers whose brief says `Size: small`. low, medium, high, xhigh or max; inherit keeps the session's effort. An explicit Agent effort, or CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL in the environment, wins.

worker_effort_normal.title: Worker effort, normal briefs
worker_effort_normal.description: Advanced: Reasoning effort for workers whose brief says `Size: normal`. low, medium, high, xhigh or max; inherit keeps the session's effort. An explicit Agent effort, or CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL in the environment, wins.

worker_effort.title: Worker effort, large briefs
worker_effort.description: Advanced: Reasoning effort for workers of size large or with no Size line. low, medium, high, xhigh or max; inherit keeps the session's effort. An explicit Agent effort, or CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL in the environment, wins.

manager_effort.title: Manager effort
manager_effort.description: Advanced: Reasoning effort for managers. low, medium, high, xhigh or max; inherit keeps the session's effort. An explicit Agent effort, or CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL in the environment, wins.

reviewer_effort.title: Reviewer effort
reviewer_effort.description: Advanced: Reasoning effort for the reviewer. low, medium, high, xhigh or max; inherit keeps the session's effort. An explicit Agent effort, or CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL in the environment, wins.

decision_api.title: Decision API
decision_api.description: Advanced: off: the brief's `Size:` line picks the model. jev: TypeSafe's Jev decides the size at spawn (the brief text is sent to api.typesafe.ai or the jev_base_url host with typesafe_api_key, or, if only openrouter_api_key is set, to openrouter.ai). openai: an OpenAI chat model decides it (the brief text is sent to api.openai.com or the openai_base_url host; key from openai_api_key). The Size line is the fallback if the provider is unavailable. auto (the default, same as unset): not set, so the deprecated size_model applies if set, else off. off, jev and openai are explicit and always win.

size_model.title: Size model (deprecated)
size_model.description: Deprecated alias of decision_api, read only while decision_api is unset.

jev_model.title: Jev model
jev_model.description: Advanced: Jev model name used when decision_api is jev.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Advanced: The key flow sends to Jev when decision_api is jev. Kept in secure storage; a settings file can't set it.

jev_api_key.title: Jev API key (deprecated)
jev_api_key.description: Deprecated alias of typesafe_api_key, read only while typesafe_api_key is empty.

jev_base_url.title: Jev base URL
jev_base_url.description: Advanced: Where flow sends the Jev request. Empty: https://api.typesafe.ai.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Advanced: A key for reaching Jev through OpenRouter when decision_api is jev and typesafe_api_key is empty. Kept in secure storage; a settings file can't set it.

openrouter_jev_model.title: OpenRouter Jev model
openrouter_jev_model.description: Advanced: The Jev model name on OpenRouter, used with openrouter_api_key.

openrouter_base_url.title: OpenRouter base URL
openrouter_base_url.description: Advanced: Where flow sends the Jev request on the OpenRouter route. Empty: https://openrouter.ai/api.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Advanced: The key flow sends to the OpenAI-compatible API when decision_api is openai. Kept in secure storage; a settings file can't set it.

openai_base_url.title: OpenAI base URL
openai_base_url.description: Advanced: Where flow sends the OpenAI request, for a compatible endpoint. Empty: https://api.openai.com/v1.

openai_model.title: OpenAI model
openai_model.description: Advanced: OpenAI chat model used when decision_api is openai. It must support structured outputs and logprobs (not a reasoning model).

decide_inbox.title: Decision API keeps routine decisions
decide_inbox.description: Advanced: On, with decision_api jev or openai: when an agent records a decision (mcp__flow__fyi), the provider reads its text and, if it is confident the decision is routine, flow keeps it so main is not woken for it. It is listed as kept by the provider and can still be undone. Only decisions are asked about, never questions, deploys, env changes or pushes. The decision text is sent to the provider. Off: nothing is sent.

decide_handoff.title: Decision API advises at handoffs
decide_handoff.description: Advanced: On, with decision_api jev or openai: when a worker hands off, the provider reads the handoff note and, if it is confident, the manager is told to split the package (or, past max_continues, which way it leans). Advice only: max_continues is unchanged. The handoff note is sent to the provider. Off: nothing is sent.

decide_min_confidence.title: Decision API min confidence
decide_min_confidence.description: Advanced: The least confidence (0 to 1) the provider's answer needs for decide_inbox and decide_handoff to act on it. Spawn sizing has its own floor, size_min_confidence.

size_min_confidence.title: Sizing min confidence
size_min_confidence.description: Advanced: The least confidence (0 to 1) the provider's answer needs for spawn sizing to use it; below it the brief's Size line is used. 0 uses every answer.

conflict_model.title: Conflict model
conflict_model.description: Advanced: Model alias for the sub-agent the reviewer starts to resolve a merge conflict in code files or a combination failure.

manager_model.title: Manager model
manager_model.description: Core: Model alias for managers. Set explicitly so it does not follow the main session's model. Covers managers whose prompt says `Size: large` or has no Size line, and `Size: normal` unless manager_model_normal is set.

manager_model_small.title: Manager model, small tasks
manager_model_small.description: Advanced: Model alias for managers whose prompt says `Size: small`. Normal maps to manager_model_normal, large or no Size line to manager_model.

manager_model_normal.title: Manager model, normal tasks
manager_model_normal.description: Advanced: Model alias for managers whose prompt says `Size: normal`. Unset: follows manager_model, so a normal manager runs on opus unless you change either key. Aliases: sonnet, sonnet[1m], haiku, opus, opus[1m].

reviewer_model.title: Reviewer model
reviewer_model.description: Advanced: Model alias for the reviewer. Set explicitly so it does not follow the main session's model.

language.title: Language
language.description: Advanced: The language agents write PRs, briefs and reports in.

preflight.title: Pre-flight
preflight.description: Advanced: on: a manager files a pre-flight (acceptance criteria, what already shipped, dependencies, questions) before it may start workers, and you get one combined round of the questions. off: managers start workers at once. A task whose prompt has the line `Pre-flight: skip` is exempt.

ask_cards.title: Question cards
ask_cards.description: Advanced: on: the messages to the main session tell it to show blocking questions, env changes and deploy approvals as AskUserQuestion cards (clickable options plus Other). off: they stay text in the chat and the /flow inbox.

preflight_wait.title: Pre-flight wait (minutes)
preflight_wait.description: Advanced: How long a round waits for managers that have not filed before it goes to you without them.

release.title: Release at merge
release.description: Core: on: workers add changelog lines under `## [Unreleased]` and never change the version; the reviewer, once per batch after merging, moves them into a new version section, bumps the version files (patch by default; minor or major when a PR asks with the handover `release` field or a flow:minor / flow:major label) and commits "Release x.y.z". off: nothing changes.

changelog_file.title: Changelog file
changelog_file.description: Advanced: The changelog (Keep a Changelog style) the release cuts.

cleanup.title: Cleanup
cleanup.description: Advanced: auto: after each PR the reviewer merges, and when the reviewer ends, remove worktrees and local branches of finished work that are clean and on the base or in a merged PR. off: only /flow clean. Uncommitted, unpushed, locked and live work is never removed.

worker_harness.title: Worker harness
worker_harness.description: Advanced: What managers start workers with: agent (a flow:worker in this session), or a harness run in a terminal: claude, codex, gemini, opencode, or a name from the harnesses setting. Managers can still pick another one per worker.

manager_harness.title: Manager harness
manager_harness.description: Advanced: Where managers run: agent (a flow:manager in this session), or claude (a Claude Code in a terminal whose flow tools are relayed to this session). Other harnesses cannot load the plugin and fall back to agent.

reviewer_harness.title: Reviewer harness
reviewer_harness.description: Advanced: Where the reviewer runs: agent (a flow:reviewer in this session), or claude (one long-lived Claude Code in a terminal and worktree whose flow tools are relayed to this session). Other harnesses fall back to agent.

session_host.title: Session host
session_host.description: Advanced: Where workers in other harnesses run: auto (Orca when it is running, else tmux), orca or tmux.

harnesses.title: Harnesses
harnesses.description: Advanced: JSON object of harness name to a start command line, or to {start, resume?, program?, quota?, digest?}, over the built-ins, e.g. {"aider": {"start": "aider --yes-always --message-file {prompt_file}", "resume": "aider --restore-chat-history"}}. {prompt} is the prompt as one shell word, {prompt_file} its path; quota is a shell command printing a percent left; digest is codex-rollout or claude-transcript; "" removes a built-in.

min_quota.title: Minimum harness quota
min_quota.description: Advanced: A session worker whose harness reports its quota (codex built in, or a harness with a quota command) is refused, and the manager starts an agent worker instead, when less than this percent is left. 0: never refused.

base_branch.title: Base branch
base_branch.description: Advanced: Branch PRs target and the reviewer pushes to. Empty: the remote's default branch.
